source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 青帝无踪，血书难托
title: 青帝无踪，血书难托
purpose: 承接刹那芳华旧事后：白衣女子从曲声联想到神农与旧缘；她确认拓拔野是为寻访青帝而来，却说明青帝行踪不定；随后借看神帝血书，沉吟后归还并暗示血书也未必能请动青帝。画面只做无声视觉，不生成口播、字幕、歌词、血书内容或可读文字。

SH03 anchors to SC12 recollection/two-character frame to keep Tuobaye and the white-clothed woman in the same present-tense scene. SH04 anchors to Yushiqie reference for the solemn warning beat.

localization_policy.screen_text: Do not generate readable text, captions, subtitles, UI, signs, labels, plaques, speech bubbles, musical notes, English words, or clear Chinese inscriptions inside image/video.
localization_policy.letter_rule: Do not render readable blood letter contents, song lyrics, 神农, 空桑, 青帝, 木族, 刹那芳华, 蜃楼城, or any Chinese/English text. Sealed documents may appear only folded, closed, or angled away.
localization_policy.dialogue_audio: Do not ask the video model to synthesize spoken dialogue, lip-sync, flute/xiao audio, heartbeat audio, music, or sound effects. Chinese dialogue, narration, and subtitles should be added later in editing.
production_dialogue_lines: 如此说来，公子到玉屏山乃是为了寻访青帝了？
自然认识。只是近年来，青帝神龙首尾，我也寻他不着。
不知公子是否介意将神帝血书借我一看？
纵使这血书交与青帝，恐怕他也不会随你去蜃楼城。
